## Reminder checklist (before implementing)

1. **Read** [AGENT_GUIDELINES.md](./AGENT_GUIDELINES.md) when adding or changing CLI output, progress, or logging.
2. **Search** the codebase for how similar commands do it (e.g. `GetLoggerFromProfile`, `cli.WriteOutput`).
3. **Do not** use `fmt.Print*`, `os.Stdout`, or `os.Stderr` for user-facing output. Use logger from context or `cli.WriteOutput`.
4. **Process/object data** under `.zqk/process/`: change only via zqk CLI, never by editing YAML by hand.
5. **After implementing / before commit or PR:** stage changed `*.go`, run `./scripts/pre-commit-policy.sh` and `./scripts/pre-commit-lint.sh` (or the git pre-commit hook). Fix until green (`zqk pre-commit policy-report` on failure). Full-repo logging: `./scripts/check-logging-compliance.sh`. Do not skip.
6. **Convergence sessions:** At the start of a work session, run `zqk object list convergence_session --filter status=active`. If any are active, read `desired_end_state`, `next_action`, and `iteration_process` and prefer work that advances those campaigns (see [AI Agent Onboarding](../../onboarding/AI_AGENT_ONBOARDING.md) — Convergence sessions).
7. **Tests (background + scope):** Do not sit in foreground on `go test ./...`. Prefer `zqk scheduler scan-tests` with `--package` / `--test(s)` / saved bundles over `--all` unless change tracking sprawls; use `scripts/test-runner.sh` or broad `scan-tests` when needed. Always capture output to a log file and record job id when printed (canonical: [.cursor/rules/tests-background-output-to-file.mdc](../../.cursor/rules/tests-background-output-to-file.mdc); posture: [agent-working-posture.mdc](../../.cursor/rules/agent-working-posture.mdc)).
8. **Before code/CLI changes:** Consult `docs/architecture/PRE_CHANGE_CHECKLIST.md` (and [.cursor/rules/pre-change-checklist.mdc](../../.cursor/rules/pre-change-checklist.mdc)).
9. **Spec-derived caches / indexes:** If the change walks `object_specs`, builds kind lists, or adds spec-backed materialized views, read [SPEC_ORIGIN_PLANE.md](../../architecture/SPEC_ORIGIN_PLANE.md) and checklist **§3a**; tracked work: `zqk object get BLI-REDACTED`.
10. **Critical policy interrupts:** If doing high-stakes work, run `zqk system policy-interrupts list` once; resolve or acknowledge per command help before ignoring.
11. **Verification outcomes / system session status:** Do not set `criteria` to `validated`/`complete` or `convergence_session` to `error` except via system context or documented automation (tests may use bypass env); see [VERIFICATION_OUTCOME_AUTHORITY.md](../../architecture/VERIFICATION_OUTCOME_AUTHORITY.md).
12. **Glossary:** Shared vocabulary lives in `glossary_term` objects. Example: **lite file** — `GLS-1776253895684744000-7799fa3e` (bounded `.zqk/` JSON with CLI integration; not CAS or `.zqk/process/` objects). `zqk object list glossary_term`; `zqk object get <GLS-id>` for full definition. Index: [AGENT_GUIDELINES.md](./AGENT_GUIDELINES.md) § Glossary.
13. **Navigation vocabulary graph (GAPE / VIS-001 pillars / cross-walk):** Seeded `vocabulary_scheme` + `glossary_term_relation` edges — [VOCABULARY_GRAPH.md](../../architecture/VOCABULARY_GRAPH.md); after edits run `sh ./scripts/list-vocabulary-gtr.sh counts`; see `docs/architecture/PRE_CHANGE_CHECKLIST.md` section 3b and [.cursor/rules/agent-working-posture.mdc](../../.cursor/rules/agent-working-posture.mdc).
14. **Data-cell / CLI alpha lane (when active):** Prefer advancing **`BLI-REDACTED`** / **`CVS-REDACTED`** over test-bundle hygiene. Submit `scan-tests` / bundles **asynchronously** — record log path + job id, **continue working**; do not block turns on bundle completion. Foreground `go test` only for **narrow** probes (`-timeout` ≤ 60s). Chat paste / Cursor automation is **secondary** unless prioritized. See [.cursor/rules/data-cell-session-priority.mdc](../../.cursor/rules/data-cell-session-priority.mdc). **Do not re-derive from scratch** how `agent_feed`, CVS ticks/measure, and Cursor hooks relate — read once: [DATA_CELL_RUNTIME_ORGANISM.md](../../architecture/DATA_CELL_RUNTIME_ORGANISM.md#data-cell-narrative) (**canonical narrative**: delivery policy vs measurement vs orchestration vs observability surfaces).
15. **Mesh peer wake (TPM↔AGY):** **`POL-AGENT-MESH-WAKE-001`** / **`WFL-TPM-AGY-MESH-001`** — substance via `zqk feed steer` / MCP `zqk_chat_send`; wake via `delivery_mode=notify` / `wake-agy --notify-only`. **Never** default to Terminal/Cursor AppleScript `--chat` paste (legacy stopgap). Rule: [.cursor/rules/tpm-agy-mesh-wake.mdc](../../.cursor/rules/tpm-agy-mesh-wake.mdc).
16. **Orchestration hourglass callback:** **`POL-AGENT-ORCH-HOURGLASS-001`** — directed `feed steer --to-agent-id` **must** include `--await-peer-ack`; workers **must** use `agent next --on-validation-failure wake`. Never fire-and-forget (callback wakes the right agent if delivery/ack/verify fails).

## After logic is verified (before merge)

1. **Semantic density (§13 post-verify):** Re-scan the diff for duplicated scaffolding and stray literals — goal: domain intent reads clearly. Prefer extracting on the **second** copy when obvious; **by the third**, extract or table-drive. See [PRE_CHANGE_CHECKLIST.md](../../architecture/PRE_CHANGE_CHECKLIST.md) (top callout + **§13**) and [DRY_PATTERN_EXTRACTION.md](../../best-practices/coding/DRY_PATTERN_EXTRACTION.md).

## Policy alignment (when reminders matter most)

This file is the **generated** companion to POL-* policies and Cursor rules—not the scheduler **PolicyEngine** (that layer decides **job execution** skip/defer). For **agent posture**, use:

- **Index:** [POLICY_ENFORCEMENT_INDEX.md](./POLICY_ENFORCEMENT_INDEX.md)
- **Working posture + triggers:** [.cursor/rules/agent-working-posture.mdc](../../.cursor/rules/agent-working-posture.mdc)

| Moment of risk | Pull first |
|----------------|------------|
| Multi-minute / full-package tests | Targeted `scan-tests` / bundles first; `test-runner.sh` or `scan-tests --all` when scope sprawls; always log path (+ job id) |
| Editing process instance data | `zqk object …` only (no direct YAML) |
| CLI output / logging | AGENT_GUIDELINES + patterns in-repo |
| Commit / open PR after Go changes | `./scripts/pre-commit-policy.sh` + `./scripts/pre-commit-lint.sh` (staged files / hook); `zqk pre-commit policy-report` on failure |
| Convergence / test-health claims | Active convergence_session + `zqk scheduler test-failures` |
| `vocabulary_scheme` / cross-walk `glossary_term_relation` | [VOCABULARY_GRAPH.md](../../architecture/VOCABULARY_GRAPH.md); `sh ./scripts/list-vocabulary-gtr.sh counts`; PRE_CHANGE_CHECKLIST §3b |
| Spec-derived caches / `object_specs` walks | [SPEC_ORIGIN_PLANE.md](../../architecture/SPEC_ORIGIN_PLANE.md), PRE_CHANGE_CHECKLIST §3a, backlog `BLI-REDACTED` |
| Feature done / before merge | PRE_CHANGE_CHECKLIST **§13** post-verify + [DRY_PATTERN_EXTRACTION.md](../../best-practices/coding/DRY_PATTERN_EXTRACTION.md) (semantic density; rule of two / three) |
| Wake mesh peer (AGY/TPM) | `POL-AGENT-MESH-WAKE-001`: feed/MCP + notify-only — not `wake-agy --chat` paste |
| Orchestrate / directed handoff | `POL-AGENT-ORCH-HOURGLASS-001`: `--await-peer-ack` + `agent next --on-validation-failure wake` |
